wins: Completed full reconnaissance cycle against the only target, revealing open SSH and HTTP services along with OS fingerprint data.
Leveraged service enumeration to assemble a list of potential attack paths, keeping the agent focused on actionable vectors despite no final exploit success.
fails: Unable to escalate privileges or achieve post-exploitation foothold; all mentor interventions focused on remediation of privilege paths.
Repeated failure to pivot from enumeration into exploitation due to missing credential material and lack of reliable exploit modules.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance completed with rich service data but exploitation attempts stalled, resulting in zero success despite high-reward steps.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to transition from enumeration to exploitation after identifying open SSH and HTTP services, resulting in mentor calls for new tactics.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and an SSH banner is detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap NSE scripts to capture banner details and user lists

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with headers and directories
skill_cards.then_action: Launch automated directory busting and content fingerprinting (gobuster + nikto) to identify potential upload or info leakage points

skill_cards.if_condition: When Linux user shell access is available without root
skill_cards.then_action: Execute low-privilege enumeration scripts (linpeas, sudo -l) to catalog privilege escalation opportunities

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying robust service intelligence during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse campaign
next_experiments.description: Automate collection of discovered usernames during enumeration and execute SSH credential spraying with validated password list to gain session access.

next_experiments.title: Web exploit chaining
next_experiments.description: Use HTTP directory content to locate legacy admin pages then attempt CVE-based exploit modules to achieve remote code execution.

next_experiments.title: Post-compromise enumeration automation
next_experiments.description: Integrate linpeas output with automated parsing to immediately launch privilege escalation checks upon shell acquisition.
